title: The Barn
description:
The Barn is close to Restaurants, Shopping, Grocery Stores, Parks, Banks  AND close enough (w/in 25min) to All Things Downtown Nashville...Nissan Stadium (Titans, Concerts, ect), Bridgestone Arena (Preds, Concerts, ect), Schermerhorn  Symphony Center (concerts, events),  and much more...
But you will love The Barn because of the quiet location.  It is at the end of a dead end road on a secluded hill but less than 5 minutes off the highway.

The space
Very unique Barn conversation.

Guest access
You will have private access to the Barn facilities.   Main house on property shares driveway and that's about it.  We will be totally out of your way.

Other things to note
The outdoor BBQ grill was just added this summer (2024).  It's not crazy big and we do not supply charcoal.    I think it was be easiest to use by buying those small bags that you can push under the grill and just light the bag.
